_comment: Locked PRIMARY-study scenario config (r27 §5, completed r28 §5). All entries are DESIGN PARAMETERS (a configuration choice, NOT a result). The primary action spec is generated deterministically from this file by generate_primary_action_spec.py. N_primary must equal config_schema.md's preregistered N_primary=8.
class_map_rule: device static_i has class 'static' (static industrial sensor); device mobile_j has class 'mobile' (AMR/AGV). The ordered device ids are static_0..static_{n_static-1} then mobile_0..mobile_{n_mobile-1}.
n_max_rule: per-class per-device subchannel cap N_max_k in the CANONICAL domain 1..N_primary (r30 §4): static devices use n_max_static, mobile devices use n_max_mobile (NOT silently N_primary; N_max=0 is not permitted — a disabled device is removed from the canonical set).
per_device_total_power_cap_rule: uniform per-device total transmit-power cap across a device's assigned subchannels: P_tot_k = per_device_total_power_cap_w for every device (watts).
beam_validity_rule: in the primary scenario every (subchannel, beam) pair is valid (beam_forbidden = empty) and every (subchannel, power) pair is valid (power_forbidden = empty); the delayed/noisy-CSI beam-observation reopening (gate criteria 7/8) is handled separately and does NOT change this on-paper validity set.

power_cap_state_schema.slot_start_state.eligible: mapping device_id -> nonnegative int eligible-packet count at slot start
power_cap_state_schema.slot_start_state.power_cap: mapping device_id -> nonnegative finite per-device total-power cap in watts (equals per_device_total_power_cap_w in the primary scenario)

ordering_rule.device: static devices first in ascending index (static_0..static_{Ks-1}), then mobile devices in ascending index (mobile_0..mobile_{Km-1})
ordering_rule.power: power level ascending by watts (power_0 is the smallest watt value)

design_justification.n_static=6, n_mobile=2: 8 uplink devices matched to N_primary=8 subchannels; a static-majority industrial floor (6 fixed sensors) with 2 mobile AMR/AGV, reflecting the static-vs-mobile distinction in the accepted abstract. DESIGN FACTOR (not a measured value).
design_justification.codebook_size B=8: finite DFT receive codebook of size B=8 for the locked n_antennas=8 ULA (one beam per array steering index). B=8 and n_antennas=8 are DESIGN FACTORS (a design choice, not an external measured value). Only the DFT/ULA codebook FAMILY (not the numeric size 8) has literature provenance (S12/S19); the numeric B=8=n_antennas is preregistered, not sourced.
design_justification.power_levels P=4: 4 discrete uplink power levels give a small tractable discrete power action. DESIGN FACTOR.
design_justification.power_level_watts: [0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4] W — geometric (x2) spacing spanning ~9 dB. DESIGN FACTOR / SENSITIVITY (exact watts to be swept in sensitivity analysis).
design_justification.n_max_static=3, n_max_mobile=2: per-class subchannel caps (< N_primary) that let a device occupy several subchannels but not monopolise all 8. DESIGN FACTOR.
design_justification.per_device_total_power_cap_w=0.8: per-device total-power cap = 2 x the max single-subchannel power (0.4 W), allowing at most two max-power allocations per device. DESIGN FACTOR.

grid_classification_rule: r31 §6: the COMMITTED primary action alphabet ALWAYS uses primary_power_grid_w (PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR). power_grid_sensitivity_variants_w are SENSITIVITY_VALUE alternatives evaluated only as separate, versioned scenarios/specs; they never replace the primary grid in the committed primary_action_spec.json. The same primary-vs-sensitivity split applies to N_max (primary n_max_static=3/n_max_mobile=2) and the per-device power cap (primary 0.8 W).

design_parameter_register._classification_note: r29 §10 / r31 §6: a project config is NOT an external scientific source. Only genuine external literature provenance is 'sourced'; every numeric project choice (N_primary=8, B=8, n_antennas=8, the primary power grid, per-class N_max, per-device cap) is a PREREGISTERED_DESIGN_FACTOR. SENSITIVITY_VALUE entries are alternatives swept in separate versioned scenarios and never appear in the committed primary spec.
sourced: DFT/ULA codebook FAMILY (S12/S19 provenance) — FAMILY only, NOT the numeric size
sensitivity_values: power_grid_sensitivity_variants_w (alternative power grids, separate versioned specs)
unresolved: P_bar average-power budget value (pending a verified industrial reference)
per-class LPPO budgets rho_c / epsilon_c / eta_c
packet size / queue capacity / deadlines / max retransmissions
